prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1088; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the collision described in the enclosed materials, and all further communication regarding this matter should be directed to our office rather than to our client. Please do not contact the client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or through any third party acting on the insurer's behalf.

We ask that you provide a written statement of the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, together with confirmation of whether any excess or umbrella coverage applies. Please also identify the claims representative assigned to this file.

Our client sustained injuries in a low-speed head-on impact, and the medical treatment and recovery are ongoing. We therefore request that the insurer preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, repair and salvage records, witness statements, recorded calls, claim notes, and any telematics or dashcam footage. Please suspend any routine destruction of such materials.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
